speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Ascent locked. All seventeen captives are aboard. The lift is clear of sub-level six.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Ascent locked. All seventeen captives are aboard. The lift is clear of sub-level six.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Their breathing is settling. Easy now. You are safe. No one is putting you back in those pods.
subtitle: OCEANUS: Their breathing is settling. Easy now. You are safe. No one is putting you back in those pods.

speaker: AURA
text: The voices in the network are fading. The forced link is broken. Their minds belong to them again.
subtitle: AURA: The voices in the network are fading. The forced link is broken. Their minds belong to them again.

speaker: TITAN
text: Pressure is venting into the geothermal sinks. The walls held. Downtown Core is still standing.
subtitle: TITAN: Pressure is venting into the geothermal sinks. The walls held. Downtown Core is still standing.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: I pulled the vault orders. Every pod, every transfer, signed off by the Citadel. This goes all the way up.
subtitle: MIRAGE: I pulled the vault orders. Every pod, every transfer, signed off by the Citadel. This goes all the way up.

speaker: SURYA
text: The surface corridor is clear. Medics and transit crews are waiting at the maintenance junction.
subtitle: SURYA // COMMS: The surface corridor is clear. Medics and transit crews are waiting at the maintenance junction.

speaker: SURYA
text: Citadel command has spotted the breach. Their orbital defenses are turning toward the upper sectors.
subtitle: SURYA // COMMS: Citadel command has spotted the breach. Their orbital defenses are turning toward the upper sectors.

speaker: KAITO
text: They buried living people down here. Today the Cyber-Grave is empty. Every captive comes home with us.
subtitle: KAITO: They buried living people down here. Today the Cyber-Grave is empty. Every captive comes home with us.

speaker: KAITO
text: Tend to the wounded. We rest for an hour, then take the fight to the Spire. Axiom Force, ascend.
subtitle: KAITO: Tend to the wounded. We rest for an hour, then take the fight to the Spire. Axiom Force, ascend.
